sources.title: kiel2/KielForge-HD · Hugging Face
sources.snippet: KielForge-HD is a high-fidelity, high-definition text-to-image typography model built on top of the FLUX.1 [dev] architecture. This model represents a direct generation upgrade from the SDXL-based KielForge-fast, utilizing a significantly expanded dataset matrix to achieve clean, crisp text rendering alongside complex prompt structures.
